`cohort` (string): Cohort identifier (e.g., `nse_large_cap`) - `batch_id` (string): Batch identifier - `generations` (integer): Number of GA generations (default: 50) - `population` (integer): Population size (default: 100) - `mutation_rate` (float): Mutation rate (default: 0.01) - `crossover_rate` (float): Crossover rate (default: 0.7) - `elite_count` (integer): Number of elite individuals (default: 5) - `fitness_metric` (enum): `sharpe` | `sortino` | `calmar` | `expectancy` ### Outputs - Progress bar showing generation count - Live fitness score updates - Final genome export button ### API Endpoint `POST /api/ga/run` **Request body:** ```json { "cohort": "string", "batch_id": "string", "generations": 50, "population": 100, "mutation_rate": 0.01, "crossover_rate": 0.7, "elite_count": 5, "fitness_metric": "sharpe" } ``` **Response:** ```json { "run_id": "string", "status": "running" | "complete" | "error", "generation": 0, "best_fitness": 0.0, "genome": {} } ``` ## Inspect Strategy Tab ### Inputs - `strategy_id` (string): Strategy identifier ### Outputs - Fitness score - Drawdown metrics - Trade count - Win rate - Sharpe ratio - Sortino ratio - Calmar ratio - Expectancy - Narrative trace blocks (showing reasoning steps) ### API Endpoint `GET /api/strategy/{strategy_id}` **Response:** ```json { "strategy_id": "string", "fitness": 0.0, "drawdown": 0.0, "trade_count": 0, "win_rate": 0.0, "sharpe": 0.0, "sortino": 0.0, "calmar": 0.0, "expectancy": 0.0, "narrative": [ { "label": "string", "value": "string", "state": "active" | "divergent" | "dimmed" } ] } ``` ## Compare Strategies Tab ### Inputs - `strategy_a_id` (string): First strategy identifier - `strategy_b_id` (string): Second strategy identifier ### Outputs - Side-by-side metric comparison - Verdict panel (which strategy wins) - Confidence score - Narrative comparison ### API Endpoint `GET /api/strategy/compare?a={strategy_a_id}&b={strategy_b_id}` **Response:** ```json { "strategy_a": {}, "strategy_b": {}, "verdict": "A" | "B" | "tie", "confidence": 0.0, "narrative": [] } ``` ## Global Ranking Tab ### Inputs - `cohort` (string): Filter by cohort - `limit` (integer): Number of results (default: 20) - `sort_by` (enum): `fitness` | `sharpe` | `sortino` | `calmar` ### Outputs - Ranked list of strategies - Each row: rank, strategy_id, fitness, sharpe, sortino, calmar, cohort ### API Endpoint `GET /api/ranking?cohort={cohort}&limit={limit}&sort_by={sort_by}` **Response:** ```json { "rankings": [ { "rank": 1, "strategy_id": "string", "fitness": 0.0, "sharpe": 0.0, "sortino": 0.0, "calmar": 0.0, "cohort": "string" } ] } ``` ## Design System - All components use `cs-*` CSS class prefix - Color tokens: `--cs-bg`, `--cs-surface`, `--cs-border`, `--cs-text`, `--cs-accent`, `--cs-muted` - Typography: monospace for metrics, sans-serif for labels - It consists of: - A React UI (`my-chrono-sentiment-ui`) for running GA optimization, inspecting strategies, comparing strategies, and viewing global rankings. - An observatory module for monitoring and suppression. - Multiple Python backend scripts for live sessions, replay certification, cohort management, symbol health, storage governance, and scheduling. - A Rust `cs-ingest` binary for high-performance candle ingestion. ## System Components ### React UI - Located at `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/` - Built with React 18 - Uses custom `cs-*` CSS design system - Communicates with backend via REST API ### Observatory - Located at `observatory/` - Static HTML/JS/CSS dashboard - Reads from JSON data files - No backend dependency ### Python Scripts - Located at `scripts/` - Each script is standalone with `--help` support - Scripts: `run_live_session.py`, `certify_replay_chain.py`, `compare_replay_equivalence.py`, `freeze_cohort_candles.py`, `verify_cohort_baseline.py`, `symbol_health.py`, `storage_governor.py`, `governor_refresher.py`, `observatory_scheduler.py`, `candle_substrate.py`, `run_nse_cohort.py` ### Rust cs-ingest - Located at `cs-ingest/` - High-performance candle ingestion - Called by Python scripts via subprocess ### Backend API - Located at `app.py` (root) - Flask-based REST API - Endpoints: `/api/ga/run`, `/api/ga/status/{run_id}`, `/api/strategy/{strategy_id}`, `/api/strategy/compare`, `/api/ranking` ## Data Flow 1. Python scripts ingest candle data via cs-ingest 2. Data stored in `data/` directory 3. Backend API reads from `data/` and serves to React UI 4. Observatory reads directly from JSON files ## Directory Structure ``` ChronoSentiment_MEGA_FINAL/ ├── app.py # Flask backend ├── my-chrono-sentiment-ui/ # React frontend ├── observatory/ # Static observatory dashboard ├── scripts/ # Python ingestion/management scripts ├── cs-ingest/ # Rust ingestion binary ├── data/ # Data storage ├── docs/ # Documentation ├── cohorts/ # Cohort definitions ├── genomes/ # Stored genomes └── results/ # Results storage ``` # VSCode Visible Files my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/index.css # VSCode Open Tabs my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/App.js,my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/GlobalRanking.js,my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/CompareStrategies.js,my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/RunGA.js,my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/StrategyColumn.js # Current Time 23/05/2026, 8:45:44 pm (Asia/Calcutta/UTC+5:30) # Current Context Size (Tokens) (Not available) # Current Cost $0.00 # Current Mode code Coding claude-sonnet-4-5 ==== REMINDERS Below is your current list of reminders for this task.
